speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: The painting of turbine blades has been completed, and monitoring shows a significant reduction in bird collisions along migration routes.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: This measure strengthens Arcadia’s compliance with its obligations under the Ramsar and Bonn Conventions, supporting SDG 15.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD REPRESENTATIVE
text: However, the altered visual appearance of the wind farm is having a noticeable impact on coastal tourism experiences.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD REPRESENTATIVE
text: Visitor satisfaction is declining in key viewing areas, and local businesses report reduced seasonal revenue.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: This creates a trade-off between ecological protection (SDG 15) and coastal economic sustainability (SDG 8).

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The implementation phase is complete. The Cabinet will now evaluate the combined policy outcomes.
